module.purpose: Provides low-level utilities to register and remove DOM event listeners with explicit bubble/capture phase and passive flag options for React DOM event system.
module.summary: This module is a small collection of pure wrapper functions around the native EventTarget addEventListener and removeEventListener APIs. It exposes helpers to attach listeners in bubble or capture phase, optionally with passive behavior, and to detach them. Each add helper returns the listener reference to allow later removal. The module contains no state and simply forwards calls to the DOM with the appropriate options object or boolean.
module.businessContext: Part of React DOM's event binding layer. If broken, React cannot correctly attach or detach events to DOM nodes, breaking all interactivity.
functions: addEventBubbleListener (~L10-17): Adds bubble-phase event listener and returns it.
addEventCaptureListener (~L19-26): Adds capture-phase event listener and returns it.
addEventCaptureListenerWithPassiveFlag (~L28-39): Adds capture listener with passive option.
addEventBubbleListenerWithPassiveFlag (~L41-51): Adds bubble listener with passive option.
removeEventListener (~L53-60): Removes event listener with capture flag.

mutationOfArg: Mutates EventTarget by adding event listener via target.addEventListener
Mutates EventTarget by removing event listener via target.removeEventListener

moduleContractTests.scenario: Adding a bubble listener registers the listener with useCapture set to false
moduleContractTests.then: target.addEventListener was called with ('click', listener, false)
moduleContractTests.rationale: Guarantees bubble-phase listening is attached with useCapture=false

moduleContractTests.scenario: Adding a capture listener registers the listener with useCapture set to true
moduleContractTests.then: target.addEventListener was called with ('click', listener, true)
moduleContractTests.rationale: Guarantees capture-phase listening is attached with useCapture=true

moduleContractTests.scenario: Adding a capture listener with passive flag passes an options object containing capture:true and passive
moduleContractTests.then: target.addEventListener was called with ('scroll', listener, { capture: true, passive: true })
moduleContractTests.rationale: Guarantees passive capture listeners use the options object form with correct flags

moduleContractTests.scenario: Adding a bubble listener with passive flag passes an options object containing passive without capture
moduleContractTests.then: target.addEventListener was called with ('wheel', listener, { passive: false })
moduleContractTests.rationale: Guarantees passive bubble listeners omit capture from the options object

moduleContractTests.scenario: Removing a listener delegates to removeEventListener with the same capture flag value
moduleContractTests.then: target.removeEventListener was called with ('click', listener, true)
moduleContractTests.rationale: Guarantees removal mirrors the capture flag used during attachment

units.name: addEventBubbleListener

detail.name: addEventBubbleListener
detail.signature: export function addEventBubbleListener(target: EventTarget, eventType: string, listener: Function): Function
preconditions: target must be a valid EventTarget supporting addEventListener.
eventType must be a non-empty string.
listener must be a callable Function.
postconditions: The listener is registered on target for eventType in bubble phase.
The returned value is the exact same listener reference passed in.
invariants: Returned listener reference identity equals the input listener.
edgeCases: Calling with the same (target, eventType, listener) multiple times registers the listener repeatedly.
If target does not support addEventListener, an error may be thrown at runtime.
stateMutations: Registers listener on target via addEventListener (target's internal listener list).
detail.summary: Registers an event listener in bubble phase on the given target for the specified event type, returning the same listener function for convenience.

units.name: addEventCaptureListener

detail.name: addEventCaptureListener
detail.signature: export function addEventCaptureListener(target: EventTarget, eventType: string, listener: Function): Function
preconditions: target must be a valid EventTarget with addEventListener method
listener must be a callable Function
postconditions: listener is added to target's event listeners with capture=true
the same listener function is returned to caller
edgeCases: If target is not an EventTarget, calling target.addEventListener throws TypeError
If eventType is invalid or empty, DOM addEventListener handles per specification without extra logic in this function

raises: TypeError if target.addEventListener is not a function

stateMutations: target's event listener registry (adds capture-phase listener)
detail.summary: Registers an event listener on the given target for the specified event type in the capture phase and returns the listener reference for later removal.

units.name: addEventCaptureListenerWithPassiveFlag

detail.name: addEventCaptureListenerWithPassiveFlag
detail.signature: export function addEventCaptureListenerWithPassiveFlag(target: EventTarget, eventType: string, listener: Function, passive: boolean): Function
preconditions: target must be a valid EventTarget (e.g. Element, Document, Window) that supports addEventListener
eventType must be a non-empty string
listener must be a callable Function
postconditions: target has a capture-phase listener registered for eventType with passive set to the provided boolean
the returned value is the exact same listener reference passed in
invariants: the registration uses capture mode unconditionally (capture: true)
the passive flag is propagated verbatim, never defaulted or coerced
the function returns the very same listener object it was given (no wrap)
edgeCases: empty eventType string: target.addEventListener silently accepts it (no throw)
non-function listener: target.addEventListener will throw a TypeError
passive coerced by addEventListener: per spec, if passive is true the listener cannot call preventDefault; no coercion happens inside this function
null/undefined target: throws a TypeError from addEventListener
duplicate registrations: each call adds another identical capture listener

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: delegates to target.addEventListener which throws TypeError for invalid listener or target

detail.summary: Registers a single event listener in the capture phase with an explicit passive flag and returns the same listener function reference.

specLiterals.role: options object passed verbatim to EventTarget.addEventListener, committing to capture:true and a caller-controlled passive boolean

units.name: addEventBubbleListenerWithPassiveFlag

detail.name: addEventBubbleListenerWithPassiveFlag
detail.signature: export function addEventBubbleListenerWithPassiveFlag(target: EventTarget, eventType: string, listener: Function, passive: boolean): Function
preconditions: target is an EventTarget supporting addEventListener
postconditions: listener is added to target via addEventListener with options { passive }
edgeCases: passive true sets passive:true; passive false sets passive:false (option object always present)
No deduplication of identical listeners is performed

raises: TypeError if target.addEventListener is not a function

detail.summary: Registers a bubble-phase event listener on a target with a configurable passive flag, returning the listener for later removal.

specTests.then: target.addEventListener called with ('click', listener, {passive:true}) and returned value === listener

units.name: removeEventListener

detail.name: removeEventListener
detail.signature: export function removeEventListener(target: EventTarget, eventType: string, listener: Function, capture: boolean): void
preconditions: target must be a valid EventTarget instance
eventType must be a non-empty string matching a valid event name
listener must be a callable Function reference
postconditions: The specified listener is removed from the target for the given eventType and capture phase
invariants: No internal state or side effects are produced outside the DOM event system
edgeCases: If the listener was not previously registered, the call is a no-op
If target does not implement removeEventListener, a TypeError may be thrown by the DOM

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Throws a TypeError if target is not a valid EventTarget

detail.summary: Removes a previously registered event listener from the given target by delegating to target.removeEventListener with the same eventType, listener, and capture flag.
